routing: Worker-authored repairs: route into the owner's active editorial application with a separate reviewer. All accepted prior editorial receipts r0001-r0016 are retained unchanged; befores are the current text after those repairs. These repairs are separate from the closed-schema identity reports and do not approve anything by themselves.

englishRepairs.before: Emperor Daizong summoned him for audience, promoted him to palace censor, and bestowed gold-purple insignia.
englishRepairs.after: Emperor Daizong summoned him for audience, promoted him to Assistant Director of the Palace Administration, and bestowed gold-purple insignia.
englishRepairs.reason: 殿中丞 is the Assistant Director of the Palace Administration (殿中省), not a censorial post; "palace censor" renders 殿中侍御史, a different office.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 代宗召見，擢殿中丞，賜金紫。

englishRepairs.before: Emperor Daizong received him at court, promoted him to palace censor, and awarded the gold-and-purple regalia of high rank.
englishRepairs.after: Emperor Daizong received him at court, promoted him to Assistant Director of the Palace Administration, and awarded the gold-and-purple regalia of high rank.
englishRepairs.reason: Same office 殿中丞 as the literal field; the idiomatic repeats the wrong title "palace censor".

sourceWitness.excerpt: 代宗召見，擢殿中丞，賜金紫。

englishRepairs.before: Emperor Dezong ordered the armies to join in a combined attack; his cousin by the father's line Wei surrendered Xuzhou, the great general Li Shizhen offered De Prefecture, and Li Changqing offered Di Prefecture. Na resented Wei for turning against him, and because Xu was rugged and well defended, he sent all his troops against Wei.
englishRepairs.after: Emperor Dezong ordered the armies to join in a combined attack; his paternal uncle Wei surrendered Xuzhou, the great general Li Shizhen offered De Prefecture, and Li Changqing offered Di Prefecture. Na resented Wei for turning against him, and because Xu was rugged and well defended, he sent all his troops against Wei.
englishRepairs.reason: 其從父洧: 從父 is a paternal uncle (father's cousin-brother), not a cousin. The extraction itself already records c0695 kin-of with kinshipTerm 從父 'paternal uncle'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 德宗詔諸軍合討，其從父洧以徐州歸，大將李士真以德州、李長卿以棣州送款，納恚洧背己，且徐險集，悉兵攻洧。

englishRepairs.before: Emperor Dezong ordered a general assault; Na's clansman Li Wei defected with Xuzhou, while Li Shizhen surrendered Dezhou and Li Changqing surrendered Di Prefecture. Furious at Wei's betrayal and mindful of Xuzhou's rugged defenses, Na threw his entire army against him.
englishRepairs.after: Emperor Dezong ordered a general assault; Na's paternal uncle Li Wei defected with Xuzhou, while Li Shizhen surrendered Dezhou and Li Changqing surrendered Di Prefecture. Furious at Wei's betrayal and mindful of Xuzhou's rugged defenses, Na threw his entire army against him.
englishRepairs.reason: 從父 states the specific kinship (paternal uncle); "clansman" drops it. Builds on the current text after accepted repair r0001.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 德宗詔諸軍合討，其從父洧以徐州歸，大將李士真以德州、李長卿以棣州送款，納恚洧背己，且徐險集，悉兵攻洧。

englishRepairs.before: Shigu was near death; Wujun regarded him as weak, and moreover none of Na's seasoned generals remained, so he led troops to take Hadu and the Three Forks.
englishRepairs.after: Shigu had only just succeeded to the command; Wujun regarded him as weak, and moreover none of Na's seasoned generals remained, so he led troops to take Hadu and the Three Forks.
englishRepairs.reason: 師古殆襲 states that Shigu had just inherited his father's command (Na died in s0040; Jiu Tangshu has 師古初立). Nothing says he was ill or dying, and he is active through s0045-s0055. "Near death" invents a fact; the paired extraction claim c0729 status ill/near-death is held in the identity report.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 師古殆襲，武俊易其弱，且納時將無在，乃率兵取蛤𧊶|虫朵、三汊。

englishRepairs.before: With Shigu gravely ill, Wujun judged him an easy mark; Na's veteran commanders were gone as well, so Wujun marched and seized Hadu and the Three Forks.
englishRepairs.after: With Shigu only newly installed in his father's place, Wujun judged him an easy mark; Na's veteran commanders were gone as well, so Wujun marched and seized Hadu and the Three Forks.
englishRepairs.reason: Same reading of 師古殆襲 as the literal repair: newly succeeded, not gravely ill.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 師古殆襲，武俊易其弱，且納時將無在，乃率兵取蛤𧊶|虫朵、三汊。

englishRepairs.before: At that time, several tens of the defender, defense generals, and Duting post clerks had all secretly received appointments from Shidao and served as spies, so none knew.
englishRepairs.after: At that time, several tens of men—the regency's defense generals and the clerks of the Duting post station— had all secretly received appointments from Shidao and served as spies, so none knew.
englishRepairs.reason: 留守、防禦將、都亭驛史數十人 lists several dozen subordinates (the regency command's defense generals and post-station clerks). "The defender" makes Regent Lü Yuanying himself one of Shidao's spies, which contradicts s0078/s0080, where he raids the lodge and uncovers the plot.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 於時，留守、防禦將、都亭驛史數十人，皆陰受師道署職，使為诇察，故無知者。

englishRepairs.before: Dozens of Luoyang officials—the defender, garrison commanders, and post-house clerks—had all been secretly on Shidao's payroll as spies, which is why the plot went undetected.
englishRepairs.after: Dozens of men in Luoyang—garrison commanders under the regency and clerks of the Duting post station—had all been secretly on Shidao's payroll as spies, which is why the plot went undetected.
englishRepairs.reason: Same correction as the literal field: the regent (defender) Lü Yuanying was not among the spies.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 於時，留守、防禦將、都亭驛史數十人，皆陰受師道署職，使為诇察，故無知者。

englishRepairs.before: Their bodies lay unclaimed until the gentleman Yingxiu gave them burial outside the west gate.
englishRepairs.after: Their bodies lay unclaimed until the gentleman Yingxiu gave them a temporary burial beside the city on its left (east) side.
englishRepairs.reason: 殯城左 is a temporary burial (殯, later followed by 更葬 in s0125) to the left of the city; the source names no gate, and left is not west.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 棄其屍，無敢收視者，有士英秀為殯城左。

englishRepairs.before: When Ma Zhi arrived, he reburied them with the rites due a gentleman.
englishRepairs.after: When Ma arrived, he reburied them with the rites due a gentleman.
englishRepairs.reason: 馬至 is the surname 馬 plus the verb 至 "arrived", the same verb-fusion defect as accepted r0010/r0011 (李宇謀曰). The given name "Zhi" is invented; the record name claim c0338 is held in the identity report.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 馬至，以士禮更葬。

englishRepairs.before: When Ma Zhi came, he reburied them with full ceremonial honors.
englishRepairs.after: When Ma arrived, he reburied them with full ceremonial honors.
englishRepairs.reason: Same 馬至 = "Ma arrived" correction as the literal field.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 馬至，以士禮更葬。

englishRepairs.before: Wu had long been on bad terms with Shidao's wife Lady Wei; she falsely claimed descent from Duke Zheng's campaign lineage, that she had not died but been taken into the palace women, and all other clansmen were exiled far away.
englishRepairs.after: Wu had long carried on an illicit liaison with Shidao's wife Lady Wei; he falsely declared her a descendant of Wei Zheng, Duke of Zheng, so she was not put to death but confiscated into the palace women's quarters, and all the other clansmen were exiled far away.
englishRepairs.reason: 悟素與師道妻魏亂: 與…亂 is an illicit sexual liaison, not a quarrel. 妄言鄭公征之裔: 鄭公征 is Wei Zheng (魏徵, Duke of Zheng, with 征 for 徵), not a "campaign lineage"; the subject continues as 悟. 不死，沒入掖廷: as a result she was spared execution and confiscated into the palace (掖廷). The current English reverses the relationship and attributes the false claim to her.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 悟素與師道妻魏亂，妄言鄭公征之裔，不死，沒入掖廷，它宗屬悉遠徙。

englishRepairs.before: Wu had long feuded with Shidao's wife Lady Wei, who falsely claimed to be a survivor of the Zheng clan purged into the palace women's quarters; the rest of the Li kindred were exiled.
englishRepairs.after: Liu Wu, long Lady Wei's secret lover, falsely passed her off as a descendant of Wei Zheng, Duke of Zheng, so Shidao's wife was spared and sent into the palace women's quarters; the rest of the Li kindred were exiled.
englishRepairs.reason: Same corrections as the literal field: liaison not feud, Wei Zheng not "the Zheng clan", and Liu Wu (not Lady Wei) made the false claim that spared her.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 悟素與師道妻魏亂，妄言鄭公征之裔，不死，沒入掖廷，它宗屬悉遠徙。

englishRepairs.before: In his ninth year he visited court and was showered with honors—acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, a grand mansion, and palace women.
englishRepairs.after: In the ninth year [of Zhenyuan] he came to court and was showered with honors—acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, a grand mansion, and palace women.
englishRepairs.reason: 九年 is the regnal era year (Zhenyuan 9), not the ninth year of Rihua's own tenure.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 九年來朝，寵遇加等，進檢校尚書右僕射，賜大第、宮女。

englishRepairs.before: Five years later Huaixin died; his son Quan took over military affairs and was issued an edict as acting governor.
englishRepairs.after: Five years later Huaixin died; his son Quan took over military affairs and was appointed acting governor by edict.
englishRepairs.reason: 詔授留後 means he was granted the post of acting governor (留後) by edict; the current wording is ungrammatical.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 後五年，懷信死，子權襲領軍務，詔授留後。

englishRepairs.before: Five years later Huaixin died; his son Quan assumed command and was issued an edict acting governor.
englishRepairs.after: Five years later Huaixin died; his son Quan assumed command and was appointed acting governor by edict.
englishRepairs.reason: Same 詔授留後 correction; the idiomatic omits the preposition and is ungrammatical.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 後五年，懷信死，子權襲領軍務，詔授留後。

englishRepairs.before: In his sixth year he visited court; Xianzong honored him lavishly and sent him back with the title acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
englishRepairs.after: In the sixth year [of Yuanhe] he came to court; Xianzong honored him lavishly and sent him back with the title acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
englishRepairs.reason: 六年 is the regnal era year (Yuanhe 6), not the sixth year of Cheng Quan's tenure.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 六年入朝，憲宗寵禮遣還鎮，加檢校尚書右僕射。

englishRepairs.before: An edict was then issued stripping his offices and titles and ordering Chongyin to lead Yan and Qi troops in advance attack.
englishRepairs.after: An edict was then issued stripping his offices and titles and ordering Chongyin to lead Yun and Qi troops in advance attack.
englishRepairs.reason: 鄆 is Yun Prefecture; accepted repair r0015 corrected only the idiomatic field, leaving the same error in the literal field.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 乃下詔削官爵，命重胤率鄆、齊兵進討。

englishRepairs.before: After Chongyin died, Li Huan and Fu Liangbi did not finish the task; Li You, great general of the Left Golden Crow Guard, was substituted; Zhixing's general Li Junmou with light troops crossed the river, by night ravaged Wudi, and induced five thousand troops of the Raoyan rampart to surrender.
englishRepairs.after: After Chongyin died, Li Huan and Fu Liangbi did not finish the task; Li You, great general of the Left Golden Crow Guard, was substituted; Zhixing's general Li Junmou with light troops crossed the river, by night ravaged Wudi, and induced five thousand troops of the Rao'an rampart to surrender.
englishRepairs.reason: 饒安 is read Rao'an (an 安), not Raoyan.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 自重胤卒後，李寰、傳良弼不終事，更以左金吾衛大將軍李祐代，而智興將李君謀以輕兵絕河，夜殘無棣，降饒安壁五千兵。

englishRepairs.before: After Wu Chongyin died, Li Huan and Fu Liangbi failed to finish the job; Li You of the Left Golden Crow Guard replaced them; Zhixing's Li Junmou crossed the river with light troops, raided Wudi by night, and induced five thousand men at Raoyan to surrender.
englishRepairs.after: After Wu Chongyin died, Li Huan and Fu Liangbi failed to finish the job; Li You of the Left Golden Crow Guard replaced them; Zhixing's Li Junmou crossed the river with light troops, raided Wudi by night, and induced five thousand men at Rao'an to surrender.
englishRepairs.reason: Same 饒安 = Rao'an correction as the literal field.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 自重胤卒後，李寰、傳良弼不終事，更以左金吾衛大將軍李祐代，而智興將李君謀以輕兵絕河，夜殘無棣，降饒安壁五千兵。

claimCorrections.reason: 悟素與師道妻魏亂 describes a long illicit liaison, not a feud.

claimCorrections.proposedAfter: Retract. Optionally record that he had newly succeeded to his father's command at s0044.
claimCorrections.reason: 師古殆襲 = Shigu had just succeeded; no illness is stated and he remains active afterward.

value.statement: Falsely claimed descent from Duke Zheng's campaign lineage and survival by entering the palace women's quarters

claimCorrections.reason: 鄭公征 is Wei Zheng; the subject of 妄言 is 悟; 不死，沒入掖廷 is the consequence for her.
